scientific.integrity: The claim is an exact two-vector consequence of the defining PCGrad projection rule. Both taskwise directional derivatives, the aggregate norm, and the raw-sum comparison are derived algebraically and replayed numerically.
limitations: Two differentiable tasks and the conflicting PCGrad branch.
First-order local progress rather than finite-step or long-horizon performance.
The multi-task sequential-projection case with three or more tasks is not classified.
Common descent degenerates at exact antiparallelity and becomes quadratically weak near it.

title: PCGrad removes two-task conflict but exactly preserves squared gradient-norm imbalance
